calls.title: Approval Flows / Teams discussion
calls.summary: The team discussed implementing a clear ownership model for resources, highlighting the importance of defining approval workflows tied to team ownership rather than individual permissions. Adriel emphasized simplifying approval processes by linking them to teams, while Jeremy proposed limiting organization-wide settings to require team ownership, thus reducing complexity. Kari suggested separating approval settings from permissions in the UI to enhance user experience. The team also addressed the governance of official metrics, proposing that they should be owned by a dedicated group rather than teams, to ensure stricter approval processes. Additionally, guardrails were suggested to prevent deadlocks in approval flows. The meeting concluded with plans to reconvene for further analysis and finalization of the approach, focusing on organizational data and usage patterns.
calls.keywords: team ownership, approval flow, official metrics, project permissions, permission management, organizational settings
